title: Community tool library
disclaimer: Fictional roadmap and evidence. No real commits, PRs, owners or completed work are represented.

goal.request: Replace a paper lending process with a small community tool library.
goal.outcome: Members can find, reserve and return shared tools without volunteer spreadsheet work.
successCriteria: Borrow-and-return works for five pilot households.
Two members cannot reserve the same tool simultaneously.
Overdue reminders are safe to retry.
constraints: Pilot before opening to the community.

answers.question: Can the pilot use the existing member login?
answers.answer: Yes, reuse the existing member login.

inputs.name: Inventory records
inputs.tradeoff: One import adapter; checkout does not read spreadsheet columns.

inputs.name: Member identity
inputs.tradeoff: Reuses authentication while keeping lending policy local.

friction.problem: Rules are duplicated in checkout notes.

notExamined: Multi-branch lending is outside this example.

options.title: Direct replacement
options.idea: Build a single checkout screen around the spreadsheet.
options.risk: Spreadsheet shape and lending rules stay coupled to the UI.
options.valueTiming: First demo fastest; more manual coordination remains.

options.title: Contract first
options.idea: Pin the catalog shape and isolate lending policy, then build parallel consumers.
options.risk: Some preparation before the first usable screen.
options.valueTiming: Storage, browsing and policy can be reviewed separately.
options.leavesBehind: One catalog contract and one lending policy.
options.chooseWhen: The library will continue after the pilot.

decision.reason: The catalog and policy will have several consumers.

questions.question: Should damaged tools automatically stop new reservations?
questions.note: Follow-up policy discussion; does not block the agreed pilot.

steps.title: Agree on lending rules
steps.does: One household can borrow up to three tools; volunteers approve the pilot.
doneWhen: One household can borrow up to three tools; volunteers approve the pilot.

steps.title: Define the catalog contract
steps.does: Inventory records expose stable tool IDs, availability and condition.
doneWhen: Inventory records expose stable tool IDs, availability and condition.
verification: Validate representative fixtures against the contract.
steps.rollback: Revert the contract before any consumer ships.

steps.title: Extract reservation policy
steps.does: Existing lending rules run through one pure policy module with unchanged results.
doneWhen: Existing lending rules run through one pure policy module with unchanged results.
verification: Run characterization cases for limits, overdue loans and cancellations.
steps.rollback: Restore the previous policy call sites.

steps.title: Audit keyboard access
steps.does: Known keyboard and screen reader gaps have reproduction steps and owners.
doneWhen: Known keyboard and screen reader gaps have reproduction steps and owners.
verification: Complete the browse, reserve and cancel audit checklist.
steps.rollback: No runtime change to roll back.

steps.title: Implement catalog storage
steps.does: The pilot inventory imports without losing tool IDs.
doneWhen: The pilot inventory imports without losing tool IDs.
verification: Compare imported IDs and counts; test failed import rollback.

steps.title: Build the browsing screen
steps.does: Members can browse tools and see their current availability.
doneWhen: Members can browse tools and see their current availability.
verification: Exercise empty, unavailable and available inventory states.

steps.title: Build checkout flow
steps.does: Eligible members can reserve and return tools with policy checks.
doneWhen: Eligible members can reserve and return tools with policy checks.
verification: Test simultaneous reservation, return and rejected requests.
steps.rollback: Disable checkout; retain existing loan records.

execution.note: Implementation is active; reservation race handling remains.

steps.title: Add return reminders
steps.does: A daily job queues one reminder per overdue loan without duplicates.
doneWhen: A daily job queues one reminder per overdue loan without duplicates.
verification: Run a dry job twice and compare queued notifications.

steps.title: Run the volunteer pilot
steps.does: Five volunteer households finish a borrow-and-return cycle.
doneWhen: Five volunteer households finish a borrow-and-return cycle.
verification: Review pilot results and confirm no lost reservations.
steps.rollback: Return volunteers to the paper checkout process.

steps.title: Write the lending guide
steps.does: Members can find lending limits, return instructions and contact details.
doneWhen: Members can find lending limits, return instructions and contact details.
verification: Coordinator checks the guide against the agreed lending rules.

steps.title: Open community lending
steps.does: Community checkout is enabled after the pilot and reminders pass.
doneWhen: Community checkout is enabled after the pilot and reminders pass.
verification: Run a production smoke check against the enabled release.
steps.rollback: Disable community checkout; keep volunteer access.

steps.title: Remove paper-only fallback
steps.does: Old-only instructions are removed and loan records remain accessible.
doneWhen: Old-only instructions are removed and loan records remain accessible.
verification: Search for retired instructions and verify record lookup.
